title: stainless steel handled pans
text: stainless steel handled pans. We use these for our seafood boils.  They are PERFECT.  Heavy duty... rolled edges.  Handles are the best.  AND they wash up beautifully.  Could be washed in the dishwasher because they are stainless - however, I hand washed mine.  I bought 4 sets (comes with one larger pan and one smaller pan).  They worked perfectly for our boil mix - seafood, potatoes, corn on the cob and sausages and because the pans have handles I don't burn my fingers with the hot body of the pan once loaded with the hot boil mix.  I am impressed with the weight of the pans and the quality of stainless.  I am back to buy a set for my daughter - she asked for a set after using them at the boil.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this review was helpful to you!
